description: Report Codex lifecycle state and turns to tmux-agent-tools.

hooks.command: if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex SessionStart; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex UserPromptSubmit; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex PermissionRequest; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex PostToolUse; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex Stop; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex Interrupt; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook codex SessionEnd; fi
